title: PARTY CARD LABELS NEVER DRAW UNDER 16PX
why: The critic scored the party cards (how to play, board, run over) on small labels: about 14px, under the 16px minimum for anything read from a couch. Table heads, the seeded night line, stat labels, best moment labels and initials lines now floor at 16px whatever the menu scale. Restyle only.
now: Small labels on the how to play page, the board and the run over card are never under 16px.
